result.title: Heuristics are Not Enough: Calibrated and Corrected Caching for Video Diffusion Acceleration
result.summary: Feature caching has become a mainstream training-free strategy for accelerating video diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs across denoising steps. However, existing adaptive methods rely on heuristic difference measures misaligned with actual generation quality, employ a single global threshold that ignores heterogeneous phase dynamics, and never validate their budget estimates against true approximation error, allowing systematic bias to propagate uncorrected. We propose \textbf{AlignCache}, a closed-loop caching framework that directly aligns scheduling decisions with their true influence on the final generated video through three tightly coupled components: (1) phase-adaptive budget routing that partitions the denoising trajectory into structurally distinct phases, each governed by an independent threshold and a staleness-aware guard; (2) closed-loop threshold calibration that exploits counterfactual error measurement at the classifier-free guided output level to adjust decision boundaries online via an EMA feedback loop; and (3) momentum-augmented draft synthesis combining direction-magnitude gated residual extrapolation with anchor-guided unconditional correction. By transforming scheduling from a static risk accumulator into a feedback-driven, self-correcting controller, AlignCache consistently achieves superior acceleration-quality trade-offs across state-of-the-art video generation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AlignCache，一个面向视频扩散模型加速的闭环特征缓存框架，用分阶段阈值路由、基于反事实误差的在线阈值校准和动量式草稿合成，来改进去噪过程中复用中间特征的调度决策。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「启发式差异度量与真实质量错位、预算估计未与真实误差核对」的诊断，以及对复用/重算决策做闭环校准的思路，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配、停止决策与 latent 相似度判据的可靠性问题提供可核查线索；但属视频生成加速场景，需人工判断迁移价值。
